run_motion_prediction_test: run the motion prediction test module with a preprocessed dataset path and saved model path to generate predictions
test_model_with_dataset: test a motion prediction model against a test dataset and return sequence predictions and MAE metrics
calculate_euler_error_metrics: calculate the mean absolute euler angle error between predicted and target motion sequences across multiple frame windows
save_predicted_motion_bvh: save predicted and reference motion sequences as BVH files using multiprocessing for parallel file output
prepare_and_load_model: prepare a seq2seq or transformer model from a saved checkpoint file and set it to evaluation mode
